description: Arcanum: Of Steamworks and Magick Obscura (Troika 2001, GOG v1.0.7.4 hotfix build 24155, via Proton)
long: Arcanum: Of Steamworks and Magick Obscura is a deep isometric role-playing game set in a world where steampunk technology and traditional magic coexist and conflict. Players create a character, choose between tech and magick paths, and shape a branching story through dialogue, combat, and character builds. It is renowned for its open-ended freedom and was developed by Troika Games.
